title: Diagnose the planted bug
prompt: The method must return the index of the **first** occurrence of the maximum. It compiles and often looks right. Trace it by hand on `{2, 9, 9}` and `{1, 3, 3, 3}` before touching the code, then fix it minimally.

tests.name: first max index
tests.hint: >= lets later equal values overwrite the winner; strict > keeps the first.
